analogy.rationale: The annotated targets KCNMA1 and S100P are not canonical immunosuppressant targets and are poorly expressed or non-specific in these cell lines, so most immunosuppressants should elicit little transcriptional response; calcineurin and mTOR inhibitors are the closest pathway analogs, while glucocorticoids and general anti-inflammatory agents share some downstream immune-metabolic programs.
